title: DOWNED CARD IS THE RAID PANEL, RUN INFO NEVER WRAPS
why: Critic on screen 34 (2 of 5): the downed card was a flat box, not the standard panel, and contract rows wrapped in run info. The card now uses the shared raid panel with a 3px danger tab, the word down as a danger label and the timer as the one hero. Run info widens to its longest row.
now: The downed card matches the other raid panels with the timer as the biggest number, and the run info panel grows leftward so no contract row breaks over two lines.
